trigger.note: Single-ST LockReSpin base game in mode 1: every round is SpinType=13, BetAmount=1000, CostCredits=0 (the legacy LockReSpin shape — M10/M23/M131/M133 — that the frozen parser short-circuits to PAID via cost_credits_unreliable, since the server never populates CostCredits on these machines), SpinTimes increments +1 per round (every round is its own paid reel spin, no grouping). The lines-lock feature fires INLINE inside the same paid ST: ReMarks=='trigger' on 1,267/40,000 rounds (3.17%) exactly when LockLines is populated (e.g. '1-2-','2-3-','1-3-'), 100% overlap. This is NOT a granted free session or a separate respin/settlement ST — it is the base reel spin with a feature flag. Server FeatureWin taxonomy has a SINGLE key 'LockReSpin' (the whole base game is the LockReSpin feature). NO trigger_paths dimension (single ST, the feature is parser-blind LockLines geometry, not a discriminator the manifest reconstructs).

validation.evidence: W1 ground truth (chunk_0002.json, single config-md5 bucket d1db8877|a2617134, _cache_version 3 REAL, _bet 1000, 40,000 rounds): SpinType tally {13:40000} (genuinely single ST); CostCredits=0 on 100% while BetAmount=1000 on 100% -> the frozen parser's cost_credits_unreliable short-circuit (parser.py L644-666, L1666-1678, M23 named explicitly) classifies all spins PAID; ReMarks {'':38733,'trigger':1267}; GameplayTriggerType constant 0; CurJackpotStoreWin=0 on 100% (test-interface-zeroed fleet pattern). Economy: WinCredits is the real win; PayoutIdToWinAmount sums EXACTLY to WinCredits on 13,183/13,183 winning rounds (natural payid, NO SynthesizePayIdRule, NO fallback bucket needed). Server FeatureWin single key 'LockReSpin'. LockLines is the LockReSpin feature field, already recognized + accumulated by the frozen parser (L1591-1595) for legacy LockReSpin machines (M10/M23/M131/M133) -> manifest-only onboard, NO new code. base RTP ~91.43% (value-agnostic, NOT pinned). Mirrors M70.json EXACTLY in shape (single paid_spin ST, native PayoutId attribution, CurJackpotStoreWin out_of_engine); differs only in ST id (13 vs 1), play ('LockReSpin' vs 'Normal'), and the LockLines feature field in the signature.
caveats: CostCredits=0 on 100% of mode-1 rounds (the legacy LockReSpin shape). The frozen parser short-circuits these machines (M10/M23/M131/M133) to PAID via cost_credits_unreliable (all-zero-cost + positive-bet). rtp_integrity.paid_st=[13] uses BetAmount as the per-round paid denominator; this is the correct paid-round RTP.

LockLines lines-lock feature is PARSER-BLIND for a per-round geometry / lock-pattern x outcome dimension (the frozen parser accumulates coarse lock-line counts only; no per-round LockLines breakout exists). The felt LockReSpin experience (lock-pattern -> win uplift) is REAL but NOT fabricated into the manifest as a dimension. Logged as a fleet-wide framework-team candidate (generic LockLines extractor) shared with the other LockReSpin machines (M10/M131/M133). M23 onboards correctly without it.
GameplayTriggerType present and constant 0 on all 40,000 rounds (not in the analyzer baseline field set; this machine emits it). Parse-as-is (constant 0); forward-compatible (in observed_fields).

Single config-md5 bucket d1db8877|a2617134 (single chunk chunk_0002.json on disk; _chunks.json also lists a chunk_0001.json that is no longer present, same md5 bucket -> no mixed-md5 pooling concern).
Modes other than 1 NOT analyzed (mode-1-only onboarding); mode dirs (if any) MUST get their own W1 + reuse pass before any reuse claim.
